sources.requests: rebuilt from data/med-synth-v4 validation drafts by draft id, streamed so that no frozen record is kept; no address, subject, or body is stored here
sources.expected: recorded once from the frozen bundle through the API; each decision and email risk agrees with the stored validation table to 1e-12
sources.desired: the product intent in docs/phase_1/SCENARIOS.md: a misdirected email should warn and a legitimate one should allow
